name: Gen-Thermal-UAV
description: Introduction. The proliferation of fixed-wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), such as loitering munitions, presents a significant challenge to airspace security. Detection relies heavily on Thermal Infrared (TIR) imaging for 24/7 passive monitoring. A critical challenge in developing these systems is the "Multiscale Approach" problem: tracking a target as it rapidly transitions from a distant sub-pixel dot to a close-range resolved object. This transition is a critical failure point for modern defense systems, known as the "handover" problem in SHORAD.
